name: Spectral Provisioner

facts.text: Level 77, 100,000 health. Immune to Heat, Spirit and Cold damage; strikes back at attackers with Spectral Strike, slowing them by 70%.
Welsh myth, not game canon: the cauldron of Annwn in Preiddeu Annwfn will not boil a coward's food.

story:
Even the dead must be fed, in their fashion, and Arawn set a provisioner over the stores of Caer Sidi. He fed the prisoners from the great cauldron, and the old song is right about one thing: it would not boil a coward's portion, and he made sure every prisoner knew it. Fire, frost and prayer were his tools, so they do not touch him now. He is all that is left of the gaol's kitchens, and he is still guarding the stores against hungry hands, slowing anyone who reaches for them.

The feeder of the dead. Even the dead must be fed, in their fashion, and Arawn set a provisioner over the stores of Caer Sidi. He fed the prisoners from the great cauldron, the one whose rim the Sacristan kept, and the old song is right about one thing: it would not boil a coward's portion, and he made sure every prisoner knew it. Fire to heat the cauldron, frost to keep the stores, and prayer to bless the meal were his tools.

Why fire fails. So fire and frost and spirit do not touch him now. He is all that is left of the gaol's kitchens, and he still guards the empty larders against hungry hands, and he strikes back at anyone who reaches for them with a blow that slows them to a crawl, as he once slowed the greedy at the serving line. He appears where the larders are when the gaol's working calls him, and when he falls, in time, the working calls him again. Albion's raids that bring all-fire caster groups to him learn something about cauldrons.
legend: Heat, cold and spirit do nothing to him; use steel and the other spell types: matter, body and energy casters are the ones he hates. He slows whoever hits him by seventy percent, so rotate the melee and keep the slowed ones healed. Do not bring an all-fire caster group. He resets a minute after the fight leaves him. The old Albion guides warned that he makes even a good melee group look slow and foolish. Rotate every thirty seconds, keep the slowed ones out of the adds, and let the matter and energy casters carry the kill. Steel and lightning, never fire.

loremasterTopic.text: The keeper of Caer Sidi's stores, who fed the dead from a cauldron that will not boil a coward's portion. Fire, frost and prayer were his tools, so they do not touch him. Bring steel.

bookPage: In the larders of Caer Sidi there is nothing to eat and something guarding it. The Provisioner turned on us the moment we stepped among the empty shelves, and our wizards threw fire at him, and frost, and he did not so much as notice, and his blows made our swordsmen move as if through deep water. Our raid leader called for the other spells, the crushing and the withering and the lightning, and those he felt. When he fell he said that someone must feed them. I do not know who he meant. I hope it is not us.
